headline: Small short-period leftovers — log the early glass or sit it out.
today: Only knee-to-waist and 4-5s, so it's marginal even on a good angle. Morning is light and clean, so if you go, go early with a log and milk anything you can. Onshore SSE kills it in the afternoon.

daysToWatch.note: 3-4ft SSE at a prime angle with N offshore all day. Best day of the stretch here — shortboard or fish.
Solid size but 20mph NNE cross-off will be textured and stiff. Surfable for the committed, not clean.
Chest-high at 6-6.7s with light morning wind. Clean early window before the afternoon onshore.
